It also sells ingredients to businesses on a wholesale basis, including tonkatsu sauce, steak sauce, Ikinari! Garlic Rice and dressings. In addition, under a license agreement with SBIC Co., Ltd., it receives royalty income from sales of products under the delivery-only brand “Ikinari! Yakiniku,” which it operates in ghost restaurants, and from sales of products “supervised by Ikinari! Steak.” Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥53 million.
entries.526979b624330bed: The company is headquartered in Sumida-ku, Tokyo, and operates a restaurant chain. It has no affiliated companies, and as of December 31, 2025 the number of employees was 351.
entries.5c27bc4f8cd0f533: Under the theme of 'Zenshin' (gradual progress), the company says it will work to raise sales at existing stores while advancing format development with an eye on trends. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company cites stabilizing earnings from existing businesses and actively advancing DX and promotion investment, preparing for overseas expansion centered on Asia and other regions with the aim of expanding its overseas store network, and planning and studying new formats that respond to diversifying food preferences and visit needs, with the aim of building formats that will become new pillars of growth.

entries.8d3014baf7de9914: It is the company’s core business. Through its proprietary store operation system using electromagnetic cookers with heat-sensitive sensors, it operates “Ikinari! Steak,” which quickly serves heat-cooked dishes such as steak, generally regarded as high-end cuisine, at affordable prices, through company-operated stores, franchises and consignment stores. It also offers the “Niku Mileage” program, which provides benefits according to the number of visits, as well as takeout and delivery services. As of December 31, 2025, there were 183 stores (130 company-operated, 48 franchised and 5 consignment), and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥13,832 million.
